title.zh: OpenAI Says People Linked to China's Moonshot Tried to Copy Its AI's Hidden Reasoning
title.en: OpenAI Says People Linked to China's Moonshot Tried to Copy Its AI's Hidden Reasoning

current_state.zh: OpenAI says it disrupted a large-scale effort to extract its models' hidden reasoning traces, tracing a core cluster of the activity to people associated with China's Moonshot AI, maker of the Kimi chatbot.
current_state.en: OpenAI says it disrupted a large-scale effort to extract its models' hidden reasoning traces, tracing a core cluster of the activity to people associated with China's Moonshot AI, maker of the Kimi chatbot.
